## OperationRegistrationError class

Registration was refused because an operation conflicts with one already registered, or a contract disagrees with its manifest.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class OperationRegistrationError extends Error
```

**Extends:** Error

## Remarks

A configuration failure raised while an app is being registered, never an invocation outcome, so it is not one of the canonical structured errors.
